answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37352 Country: India Title: Is there any mas'ala to eat chicken skin less or is it ok to eat chicken with skin Question: Is there any mas'ala to eat chicken skin less or is it ok to eat chicken with skin? Answer ID: 37352 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 508/508/M=1433) If the chicken was slaughtered on Shariah pattern and it was not put for a long time in hot water without bringing out the filth of stomach then the chicken is halal, whether one eats it with skin or without skin, it is right in each case. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
